authority: RESEARCH FOUNDATION ONLY — INSTITUTIONAL_TARGET_AND_LABEL_FOUNDATION_STAGE1_V1. No entry may be PRODUCTION_APPROVED in Stage 1. This registry names candidate outcomes and their causal contracts for a FUTURE Stage 2 baseline competition; it does NOT approve any target, claim predictive validity, calibration, or a winner.
horizon_notes: PRIMARY_DECISION_HORIZONS in ml_horizon.py:31; 'c' = one canonical 1-minute candle (1c=1m, 5c=5m, 15c=15m, 60c=60m). Threshold JSON also lists 3c/8c/13c but the DB snapshots schema materializes NO outcome column for them (O-10: 3c/8c/13c diagnostic-only, outside authoritative replay parity).

status_definitions.CANDIDATE: proposed outcome; causal contract not yet fully implemented/reconstructable in this repo
status_definitions.VALID_FOR_EXPERIMENT: implemented AND reconstructable from immutable source rows AND causal contract proven by tests/test_stage1_causal_label_contract.py; eligible as a Stage 2 entrant. NOT an approval or a validity claim.
status_definitions.INVALID: defined but dead/invalidated or non-reconstructable; excluded from experiments
status_definitions.PRODUCTION_APPROVED: FORBIDDEN in Stage 1 — no entry may carry this status

cost_model_versions.NONE: no transaction-cost term applied (raw price move)
cost_model_versions.COST_V1_UNDERLYING_SPY: research/pilot_step3/prereg_v1.json — half_spread 0.5bp/side, round_trip 1.0bp, commission 0, market_impact 0; application=post_label_only; must_not_change_classification=true. RESEARCH ONLY.
cost_model_versions.EXEC_EV_SCAFFOLD_V1: calibration/v2_a1_execution_ev.py — requires explicit execution_cost_model (fill_probability_estimate/slippage_estimate/market_impact_estimate/adverse_selection_score/capacity_participation_cap); fail-closed; training/eval-time only; runtime unchanged.

barrier_versions.PILOT_TB_V1: research/pilot_step3/labeling.py — stop/target/vertical + 15:55 ET force-flat; entry = next-bar open; Wilder ATR-14 anchored T-1; classes WIN/LOSS/TIMEOUT/FORCE_FLAT; 175-cell grid; NON-PROMOTED research.
barrier_versions.D2_TB_V1: tools/research/d2_build_dual_label_scratch_db.py — symmetric anchor +/- k_hz*ATR, vertical at N 1m bars, session-truncation flag; writes outcome_tb_{H} to data/research/d2_dual_label.db ONLY (scratch).

immutable_source.note: The ONLY authoritative price series for labels (horizon_outcomes.py:21). Labels never read snapshots.spot or quotes.

targets.formula: anchor_close = close of last price_bars_1m row with bar_end_ts_utc <= T; forward_close = close at bar_start floor((T+N*60)/60)*60; pts = forward_close - anchor_close; label = up if pts>thr, down if pts<-thr, else flat (classify_direction_pts). thr = threshold_move_pts_for_slug(anchor_close, atr).
targets.economic_meaning: sign of raw close-to-close move over N minutes, with a small dead-band; NOT cost-aware, NOT tradeability
targets.anchor_timestamp: snapshots.ts_utc (T); anchor bar = last completed 1m bar <= T
targets.causal_availability: PROVEN causal (label uses only bars <= target bar close; threshold ATR is as-of anchor); reconstructable from price_bars_1m
targets.session_policy: labeler applies NO session filter (labels every snapshot in a 14-day window); RTH enters only in threshold SELECTION and downstream cohorts
targets.label_completion_rule: written only when forward bar fully complete (tz >= b_start+60); else NULL; outcome_filled=1 iff all 4 horizons non-null
targets.overlap_policy: UNSPECIFIED — overlapping 1m anchors produce heavily overlapping horizon windows; no purge/embargo enforced at label time
targets.missing_data_policy: forward_close absent -> horizon NULL; interior gaps repaired by synthetic_interior_grid_repair_v1 + edge_carry + anchor_coverage_pad
targets.synthetic_data_policy: synthetic-repaired bars participate; NOT distinguished in the label; a synthetic/real provenance flag is a Stage 1 gap
known_limitations: flat-majority degeneracy 35-61% by horizon
threshold placeholder/ATR-fallback not percentile-fitted
no cost adjustment
overlapping-label leakage unmanaged
